items.summary: Leading quality engineering for an AI-driven data verification platform, owning the end-to-end test automation strategy across web, API and data pipelines.

Embedded automated test gates into CI/CD pipelines to catch regressions before they reach staging
Partnered with product and engineering to define acceptance criteria and testability requirements early
Mentored two junior QA engineers on automation patterns and debugging strategy
Introduced contract testing to keep microservices in sync across releases

items.summary: Owned test strategy for a low-code app generation platform, balancing fast iteration cycles with reliable release quality.
responsibilities: Built a reusable Cypress and Jest test suite shared across multiple product squads
Designed a visual regression testing pipeline for generated UI output
Reduced flaky test incidents by introducing retry-aware, deterministic test fixtures
Collaborated directly with designers to validate generated layouts against design specs
Documented test strategy and onboarding guides for new engineers

items.summary: Delivered functional and regression testing for enterprise leasing and finance software used by global banking clients.
responsibilities: Wrote and executed structured test plans for complex financial workflows
Automated core regression suites using Selenium WebDriver and Java
Logged and triaged defects in close coordination with developers and business analysts
Performed cross-browser and localization testing for international client rollouts
Contributed to the shift from manual-only to hybrid automated regression cycles

items.summary: Started my QA career validating web and mobile applications, building the fundamentals that now anchor my automation practice.

Authored clear, reproducible bug reports with severity and priority classification

summary.title: Automation-first, quality-obsessed, delivery-focused
summary.bio1: I'm Rao Muhammad Ali, a Software Development Engineer in Test who builds resilient, maintainable automation systems across web, API, and performance layers. My work spans designing test architectures, wiring them into CI/CD pipelines, and partnering closely with development teams so quality is validated continuously, not bolted on at the end.
summary.bio2: I've shipped testing strategy for products like VeridatAI and Atomic Builder, taking them from manual QA gaps to automated regression suites with measurable coverage. I care about readable test code, fast feedback loops, and building tools that make the whole team more confident in what they ship.
